name: Shenzhen Center Power Tech. Co., Ltd
summary: Operating from Shenzhen, China, Shenzhen Center Power Tech. Co., Ltd. is a prominent manufacturer and supplier of valve-regulated lead acid (VRLA) batteries within the country. Their comprehensive portfolio of VRLA battery technologies encompasses AGM, GEL, telecom-grade, deep cycle, and electric vehicle series. These robust power solutions are essential across an extensive array of applications, including but not limited to uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), telecommunications infrastructure, emergency lighting systems, renewable energy installations (solar and wind), energy storage, maritime equipment, security alarms, healthcare devices, golf carts, and various other specialized purposes. The company was established in 1994.
